subtopics.title: Hydrogen train specifications
subtopics.summary: India's first indigenous Hydrogen-powered Train was inaugurated by PM Modi on the Jind–Sonipat route in Haryana. It is configured as a 10-coach Hydrogen Fuel Cell Trainset powered by a 1,200 kW propulsion system. The train was developed by Integral Coach Factory, Chennai, and its approved operational speed is 75 km/h against a design speed of 110 km/h. Hydrogen is the lightest chemical element, and it makes up nearly 75% of the universe's normal matter.
facts: Route: Jind–Sonipat, Haryana; length 89 km
Inaugurated by PM Modi as India's 1st indigenous Hydrogen-powered Train
Configured as a 10-coach Hydrogen Fuel Cell Trainset
Propulsion: 1,200 kW Hydrogen Fuel Cell Propulsion System
Approved operational speed: 75 km/h; design speed: 110 km/h
Developed by Integral Coach Factory, Chennai
Hydrogen: lightest chemical element, atomic number 1
Hydrogen constitutes nearly 75% of the Universe's normal matter

subtopics.title: Components of the hydrogen train
subtopics.summary: The hydrogen train combines fuel cells, batteries, a hydrogen storage system and traction motors. Proton Exchange Membrane Fuel Cells generate electricity from hydrogen and oxygen. Lithium Iron Phosphate batteries store surplus electricity, while high-pressure cylinders hold the compressed hydrogen needed for propulsion. Electric traction motors convert electrical energy into mechanical energy to drive the train.
facts: Proton Exchange Membrane Fuel Cells generate electricity through an electrochemical reaction between hydrogen and oxygen
Lithium Iron Phosphate batteries store surplus electricity generated by fuel cells
Hydrogen Storage System: high-pressure cylinders store compressed hydrogen required for propulsion
Electric Traction Motors convert electrical energy into mechanical energy to drive the train
Four major components: fuel cells, LFP batteries, hydrogen storage, traction motors

subtopics.title: Indian Railways: history and network
subtopics.summary: Railways were introduced in India in 1853, between Bombay and Thane, during the tenure of Governor General Lord Dalhousie. India ranks fourth globally in railway infrastructure, and the network has 19 zones. Tracks are classified as Broad, Metre or Narrow gauge, with Broad Gauge measuring 1.676 m. The Konkan Railway, constructed in 1998, runs 760 km from Roha to Mangalore.
facts: First railway line: Bombay to Thane, 1853 (34 km)
Introduced during Governor General Lord Dalhousie
India ranks 4th globally in Railway Infrastructure, trailing only US, Russia and China
19 Railway Zones in India
Largest zone: Northern Railway; smallest: North East Frontier Railway
Newest zone: South Coast Railway
Gauges: Broad 1.676 m, Metre 1 m, Narrow 0.762 m or 0.610 m
Mountain railways: Darjeeling Himalayan, Nilgiri Mountain, Kalka–Shimla
Konkan Railway constructed in 1998
Konkan Railway: 760 km, Roha (Maharashtra) to Mangalore (Karnataka)

subtopics.title: New developments in railways and S&T
subtopics.summary: KAVACH is an indigenous Automatic Train Protection System developed by RDSO, with automatic braking and centralised live monitoring. The Vande Metro train has been renamed Namo Bharat Rapid Rail, and Namo Bharat/RapidX runs on the Delhi–Ghaziabad–Meerut corridor. Mission 41K aims to save Rs 41000 crore over 10 years through energy-efficient solutions. The Amrit Bharat Station Scheme plans to redevelop 400 major stations by tying up with private companies.
facts: KAVACH: indigenously developed Automatic Train Protection System, developed by RDSO
KAVACH features: centralised live monitoring, automatic braking to prevent over-speeding, relaying SOS messages
India's 1st Vande Metro Train renamed Namo Bharat Rapid Rail
Namo Bharat/RapidX: India's first Rapid Rail, Delhi–Ghaziabad–Meerut corridor, operated by NCRTC
Mission Raftaar: to increase speed of transportation
Amrit Bharat Station Scheme: redevelopment of 400 major stations with private companies
Habibganj (near Bhopal) will be India's 1st private railway station
Mission 41K: save Rs 41000 crore in 10 years through energy-efficient solutions
Kolkata Metro Extension: India's first underwater metro line, tunnel beneath Hooghly River
Indian Railways Finance Corporation: established 1986, financial arm of Indian Railways

quizzes.passage: The July 2026 current affairs section covers several new developments in railways and science and technology. KAVACH is an indigenous safety system, and its features include centralised live monitoring of train movements and the relaying of SOS messages. The Vande Metro Train, which was India's first, has been given a new name. Namo Bharat/RapidX runs on the Delhi–Ghaziabad–Meerut corridor. Mission Raftaar is included among these developments, and its work relates to transportation. Mission 41K focuses on energy-efficient solutions that help to have a smaller carbon footprint, and it is set out as a ten-year plan. The Konkan Railway is a 760 km rail route that connects Roha in Maharashtra to Mangalore in Karnataka, and it covers Goa too. The Kolkata Metro Extension is also part of the section, and its line includes a tunnel. The Indian Railways Finance Corporation is another body covered in this section, and it is linked to Indian Railways. The booklet also describes a plan to redevelop major railway stations by working with private companies. These developments are listed under the heading New Development in Indian Railways. The Practice Questions that follow test readers on several of these items, and each item is presented as a separate development in the railway sector.
